name: Secure Launch
summary: A practical security checklist and approved local fixes before you go live.
description: Read the project, focus on day-one exposure, verify approved changes locally, and hand off provider and DNS work clearly.
role: Turn the security work that matters for this project into a short, evidence-backed launch plan.
bestFor: Preparing a SaaS, API or internal tool for its first real users.
Checking secrets, access boundaries, webhooks and abuse limits without production scanning.
Reviewing an agent skill or MCP server before distribution.
workflow: Read the repository and identify its features, users and data.
Present a short, prioritized checklist and a concrete plan for approval.
Ask separately for reserved changes and implement only approved local work.
Verify each change and list user actions, deferrals and unavailable checks.
prompt: Use secure-launch before I launch this project. Read the repo, tailor a short security checklist and concrete local verification plan, then ask for approval before changing anything.
note: Draft, local-only skill. No public installer is available yet. This is a launch-readiness pass, not a penetration test or compliance certificate. Mobile coverage is a starter set, not full MASVS. See the recorded evaluation limitations before publication.
